competitions.title: Old Mutual Win On Repeat - Win R100,000 Rewards Points

Make at least two qualifying transactions of R30 or more each week using your OM Bank card or account.
Switch a qualifying Old Mutual debit order to a DebiCheck mandate with OM Bank to qualify for the grand prize route.
Keep participating through the campaign period, which runs until 27 September 2026.
